decision_conditions: The proposed rear and roof extensions, by reason of their design, scale, siting, form and combined visual impact, would result in a bulky, incongruous and overbearing form of development that would fail to respect the character, appearance and symmetry of the semi-detached pair. The proposal would harmfully alter the proportions and architectural composition of the host dwelling and would appear visually intrusive within the street scene, to the detriment of the character and appearance of the surrounding area, contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3, D4 and D8 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD6, DMD8, DMD11, DMD13, DMD14, DMD37 and DMD38 of the Development Management Document (2014).

The proposed two-storey rear extension, by reason of its scale, bulk, depth and siting, would result in an unacceptable loss of outlook, loss of light and an increased sense of enclosure to the occupiers of adjoining residential properties (no.74 and no.78 Deansway), causing material harm to their residential amenity. The proposal is therefore contrary to Section 12 of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan (2021), Policy CP30 of the Core Strategy (2010), and Policies DMD11 and DMD37 of the Development Management Document (2014).
description: Part single, part 2-storey rear extension, rear dormer involving front rooflights and detached outbuilding at rear.
